verdict: Organic presence held steady; local search visibility dropped sharply this week.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — the last 28 days produced 326 combined Google Business Profile actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) entirely from organic presence, with no paid spend active on any channel. Over the past 7 days, GBP engagement fell sharply across all three listings — down 84%, 92%, and 97% respectively week-over-week — a pattern that points to a broader local search visibility drop rather than any single listing issue, and is being investigated now. Search click volume declined in parallel across entities, reinforcing that organic visibility needs attention before paid channels can be responsibly relaunched. The Web/SEO root cause review is in motion, and resolving it is the first step toward stabilising the organic floor and unlocking outreach and paid activity downstream. Next period, you should expect visibility diagnostics to be completed and initial remediation underway.

watch_item.fix: The Web/SEO root cause review is being completed this period, with reindexing and listing verification to follow — the goal is to restore the organic floor before any paid activity launches on top of it.
